subject: Request to shift demo slot to accommodate newly added governance reviewers
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medigus.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medigus.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed 18 Mar

Thanks Markus — we appreciate the quick turnaround. We can do 18 Mar but our security and procurement review teams just flagged that they must attend as well.

Quick ask: can we expand the session to 90 minutes and potentially move it a few days later if needed so the right reviewers can join? Security wants to walk through authentication/keys and data residency, platform/infra will want an architecture slide, and procurement will want the pricing summary attached.

Attendees to add:
- Francesca Bianchi (Security Lead, Medigus) 
- Procurement Team (procurement@medigus.com)
- Tom Hargreaves (Platform)

We can be flexible — priority is having the governance folks in the room. If you could propose two alternate windows that accommodate those reviewers, that would be great.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships
Medigus Health

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medigus.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medigus.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed 18 Mar

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for listing the new reviewers. We definitely want Francesca and procurement in the discussion. I’ll check availability internally and come back with two windows that give us 90 minutes.

Action items for us:
- I’ll coordinate with Kimberly and Karthik to free up a security/architecture SME.
- Can you share Francesca’s calendar availability (morning vs afternoon CET) and whether procurement needs any pre-read? You mentioned a pricing summary — happy to attach an initial deck.

I’ll follow up by EOD tomorrow with concrete windows.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Redwood demo — proposed 18 Mar

Markus / Karthik — quick internal note on availability: our primary security engineer (Ewa Novak) is traveling 17–19 Mar and will be off-grid. That blocks the 18th for a meaningful security walkthrough.

Proposed alternatives (CET):
- Option A: Wed 24 Mar, 09:30–11:00 (preferred)
- Option B: Mon 22 Mar, 14:00–15:30

A few operational notes:
- If procurement will attend, please send the pricing deck and a short mutual action plan in advance. I’ll attach a short security runbook and the architecture diagram on our side.
- We should schedule 90 minutes to let Francesca/from Medigus go deep on data flows and key management.

CCing Monica to help manage the invite and record the MAP in HubSpot.

—Kimberly
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medigus.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medigus.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medigus.com>, Francesca Bianchi <francesca.bianchi@medigus.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed 18 Mar

Thanks — both windows look workable. Procurement prefers mornings; Francesca is available on 24 Mar morning CET. Tom from platform is also ok with the 24th. Can you confirm 24 Mar, morning?

Procurement (procurement@medigus.com) asked for a short pricing deck (3–4 slides) and a one-page mutual action plan before the session. Francesca also requested a high-level network diagram in the invite so she can triage questions for her team.

If you can send the documents before EOD Mon 22 Mar, we’ll distribute internally and lock the date.

Elena

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medigus.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medigus.com>, Francesca Bianchi <francesca.bianchi@medigus.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medigus.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Confirmed: Demo moved to 24 Mar (90 min) — materials attached

All — confirmed: we’ll move the demo to Wed 24 Mar, 09:30–11:00 CET. I’ve expanded the calendar invite to 90 minutes and added Francesca and procurement to the attendee list.

Attached to this thread and uploaded to the updated invite: 
- pricing-deck.pdf (concise pricing + pricing bands)
- security-runbook.pdf (summary of key management & data residency controls)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (timeline and next steps)
- redwood-medigus-demo-invite.ics (updated calendar invite)

Logistics:
- Dial-in and Google Meet link are in the updated invite (see calendar link below). Please accept the new invite so we have the right headcount.
- Kimberly and Karthik will lead the architecture and security walkthrough; Monica will own follow-ups and HubSpot notes.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/crm/deal/4821
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-medigus-demo

If anything changes for your side, flag it here and we’ll re-open windows. Looking forward to the runthrough.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pricing-deck.pdf (PDF, 4 slides); security-runbook.pdf (PDF, 7 pages); mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel); redwood-medigus-demo-invite.ics (iCal)
